<?php
class StringReviewThrowPayload {
    public function __toString(): string { echo "CAST;"; throw new Exception("fresh-cast"); }
}
$payload = new StringReviewThrowPayload;
$reader = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "ISSET;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): string { global $payload; echo "GET;"; return $payload; }
};
$selector = "value";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $reader->$selector ?? 9; }
catch (TypeError $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getLine(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getLine(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getPrevious() === null ? "ROOT;" : "BAD_ROOT;"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo "DONE;";
